concepts.label: n3-transport
concepts.gloss: A logical user-plane transport connection in the packet core that terminates at a UPF transport endpoint and carries traffic for one or more PDU sessions.
concepts.example: n3-441 terminates at upf-ep-441 and carries the user-plane packets of PDU session #8830.

concepts.label: upf-transport-endpoint
concepts.gloss: The network demarcation point on an N3 transport at which the User Plane Function sends or receives tunneled user-plane traffic.
concepts.example: upf-ep-441 is the UPF-side endpoint of n3-441.

concepts.label: n3-dscp
concepts.gloss: The DiffServ code-point marking policy applied to packets on an N3 transport to select per-hop treatment for different traffic classes.
concepts.example: On n3-441, voice packets are marked EF, selected priority traffic is marked AF41, and other packets receive the default marking.

concepts.label: n3-capacity
concepts.gloss: The required traffic-carrying rate assigned to an N3 transport for capacity planning or provisioning.
concepts.example: n3-441 has an N3 capacity requirement of 8 Gbit/s.

concepts.label: n3-mtu
concepts.gloss: The maximum packet size, in bytes, that an N3 transport can carry without transport-layer fragmentation or rejection.
concepts.example: n3-441 is configured with an MTU of 1600 bytes so packets no larger than 1600 bytes can traverse it intact.

concepts.label: qos-flow
concepts.gloss: A QoS-specific user-plane flow within a PDU session whose packets share a core-network forwarding and treatment policy.
concepts.example: PDU session #8830 contains a GBR-voice QoS flow for guaranteed-rate voice traffic and a default QoS flow for remaining traffic.

concepts.label: pdu-session
concepts.gloss: Packet-core session state representing a subscriber data connection whose user-plane packets are transported over N3 and may be divided into QoS flows.
concepts.example: PDU session #8830 provides internet data service over n3-441 and contains both GBR-voice and default QoS flows.

concepts.label: summit-tag-9
concepts.gloss: An opaque Summit-proprietary attribute numbered 9 that is attached to an N3 transport, with the meaning of its encoded value defined outside this schema.
concepts.example: n3-441 carries summit-tag-9 with the encoded value 0x4.
